marketplace.display_name: Manuscript Submission and Peer-Review Revision Specialist
marketplace.summary: Runs pre-submission QA, reporting-guideline, consistency and reference checks, anonymization, revision triage, and location-mapped reviewer responses for biomedical manuscripts without claiming experiments, analyses, or edits the authors have not supplied.

skills.name: paper-sprint-review
skills.description: Runs a multi-lens (contribution, rigor, writing, editor) manuscript review and turns findings into a prioritized revision backlog with gated sprints.

skills.name: revision-strategy-planner
skills.description: Triages editor and reviewer comments by severity and routes each to experiment, analysis, clarification, restructuring, wording, or bounded rebuttal.

skills.name: response-letter
skills.description: Assembles a Word response letter with an editor overview and Comment/Response/Changes-in-Text blocks mapped to page, paragraph, and line.

skills.name: reporting-guideline-compliance-checker
skills.description: Checks a manuscript against its design-matched reporting guideline (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, TRIPOD, or hybrid) and grades gaps by submission risk.

skills.name: consistency-checker-across-manuscript
skills.description: Finds sample-size, endpoint, terminology, figure/table/supplement, and conclusion-result contradictions and version drift across manuscript sections.

skills.name: reference-integrity-checker
skills.description: Checks that each citation supports the exact claim it is attached to, flagging mismatch, overextension, quote drift, and second-hand citation.

skills.name: author-response-builder
skills.description: Drafts point-by-point replies in accept, explain, rebut, or added-analysis mode, linked to actual manuscript changes and open about unresolved items.

skills.name: rebuttal-letter-strategist
skills.description: Frames soft-but-firm replies to a sharp or disputed reviewer criticism or an appeal; its script only grades severity and fills a response template.

skills.name: response-tone-polisher
skills.description: Rewrites defensive or confrontational draft replies into professional academic tone while keeping the author's scientific position.

skills.name: claim-strength-calibrator
skills.description: Maps manuscript claims to their evidence level and flags causal, mechanistic, validation, and translational inflation with narrower wording.

skills.name: retraction-watcher
skills.description: Parses reference lists and queries Open Retractions, Crossref, and PubMed by DOI or PMID for retractions and expressions of concern; needs network.

skills.name: cover-letter-drafter
skills.description: Drafts a five-paragraph editor-facing submission cover letter from supplied title, journal, contributions, results, and declarations.

skills.name: blind-review-sanitizer
skills.description: Masks author names, institutions, contacts, acknowledgments, and first-person self-citation phrases in .docx/.md/.txt files for double-blind review.

skills.name: figure-reference-checker
skills.description: Checks figure citation numbering in manuscript text; its bundled script only extracts 'Fig. N' mentions and does not detect orphans or label mismatches.

skills.name: arxiv-preflight
skills.description: Preflights LaTeX or PDF manuscripts for LLM residue, placeholders, AI-as-author, and fabricated or mismatched BibTeX references.

skills.name: journal-recommender
skills.description: Proposes sprint, robust, and safe target-journal tiers from topic, abstract, and target impact factor; every metric needs live verification.
